課程綱要.課程目標: 預期學生能夠透過本課程，增進對於台灣電影或台灣電影歷史的興趣，跳脫思考框架，勇於與他人溝通、辯論不同意見。最終能從台灣電影的領域裡，找到新的觀察面向。未來在接受歷史、理論論述時，也能從解殖的觀點出發，質疑西方理論或國族論述背後的動機與想像。
課程綱要.授課內容:
1 課程介紹：台灣電影編年史：台灣／中國／西方
Course introduction : historigraphy of Taiwan Cinema
2 戰前電影：沒有電影的歷史還是沒有歷史的電影？Pre-World War II cinema: The question of colonial cinema
3 戰後電影：中國電影遺緒或新殖民電影？
Post-War cinema: a new colonial cinema ?
4 1960s (1): The Golden Age of Taiyu and Mandarin Cinema
5 1960s (2): The Golden Age of Taiyu and Mandarin Cinema
6 1970 (1) : The triumph of Genre Cinema
7 1970 (2): The triumph of Genre Cinema
8 Mid-term film program presentation
9 1980s (1): Taiwan New Cinema
10 1980s (2): Taiwan New Cinema
11 1990s (1): The second Taiwan New Wave
12 1990s (2): The second Taiwan New Wave
13 2000s (1) : A cinema in crisis
14 2000s (2) : The "Cape no 7" effect
15 What about now ?
16 Final film project presentation

課程綱要.課程目標: 1. The course is open to acquire an interdisciplinary knowledge on both cinema and natural science, and English vocabulary. 2. The students will learn to analyze films in English and discuss the issues raised by the films while acquiring basic English knowledge on different natural science topics. 3. 課程綱要.課程名稱(中文): 人文應用專題：歷史導覽
課程綱要.課程目標: 自網際網路普及以來，尤其在今日人工智慧快速崛起的背景下，歷史知識的取得變得前所未有的容易。面對此一挑戰之下的人文學科，只能持續強化“說故事”此一傳統技藝，導覽工作則是詮釋此一技藝重要位置。為此，本課程的核心在於培養學生能夠以當代關懷與宏觀歷史脈絡來進行「說故事」。 本課程結合大學社會責任（USR）計畫與人工智慧（AI）技術。USR以大溪作為場域，該地兼具深厚的歷史脈絡與豐富的文化資產，卻在國際文化旅遊中相對低度能見，正好提供學生「說故事」與文化轉譯的絕佳舞台。AI 則透過智慧穿戴裝置的生理數據回饋，幫助學生理解自身在導覽過程中的專注度、壓力與表達效果，進而反思與調整學習策略；換言之，AI從挑戰者成為幫手，提供客觀的即時回饋。 本課程作為一門 EMI（English as a Medium of Instruction）課程，其目的並不止於以英文作為授課語言來加強學生外語能力，而在於引導學生在此一過程反思自身母語意涵以提升思考與表達的邏輯層次，進而掌握到歷史事件的真實意涵，培養出跨語言、跨文化的國際敘事能力。
課程綱要.授課內容:
Week 1　課程介紹與要求說明　(9/4 Thu)
Week 2　從全球茶業重鎮到沿山老城: 大溪的歷史發展軌跡　(9/11 Thu)
Week 3-4　大溪參訪：場域觀察與素材蒐集　(9/20 Sat，上午導覽、下午分組蒐集素材-提交分組名單與導覽暫定主題 ※9/25 Thu 不上課)
Week 5　如何成為優秀的導覽員　(10/2 Thu)
Week 6　歷史導覽主題規劃　(10/9 Thu)
Week 7　歷史導覽內容製作　(10/16 Thu)
Week 8　聽眾設定與語彙選擇　(10/23 Thu)
Week 9　歷史導覽路線安排　(10/30 Thu)
Week 10 運動會停課一次(11/6 Thu)
Week 11 導覽策略與工具　(11/13 Thu)
Week 12 導覽英文特性口語化敘事(11/20 Thu, 各組提交導覽企畫書)
Week 13-14 大溪參訪：QR code 線上連結設計　(11/29 Sat，各組※12/4 Thu 不上課)
Week 15 期末導覽實作　(12/11 Thu)
Week 16 期末導覽實作　(12/18 Thu)

課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Project in Humanities: Film Sales and Marketing
課程綱要.課程目標: This course has two main objectives and requires strong student engagement, as it is a practical class conducted entirely in English. Objective One: To develop students’ English proficiency in the context of the international film industry, with a focus on understanding the systems of film sales and marketing -including production, acquisition, and film curation for theatrical release. This will be achieved through case studies, assigned readings, and guest sessions with industry professionals. Objective Two: To apply this knowledge in a hands-on project. Each student group will develop a comprehensive production, sales, and marketing plan based on the adaptation of a selected manga. This project will simulate the process of bringing a manga-based film to the international market. Each session will consist of three components: Industry Reading: A guided reading and discussion of a recent article related to current trends and developments in the global film industry. Marketing Focus: A short presentation introducing a specific aspect of film marketing (e.g. poster design, festival strategy, international sales pitching). Workshop: A practical workshop in which students apply the concepts learned to their ongoing manga adaptation project.

Week 1- Course introduction - presentations of the selected manga

Week 11: Pitching session and mood board
Week 12: acquisition strategies
Week 13: distribution strategies
Week 14: marketing strategies (film distributions)
Week 15: marketing strategies (selling Taiwan film internationally)
Week 16: Final project presentation
